title: Link preloading demand lines to live explicit sales order detail evidence
description: Stage3 core inventory closure. Use genuine authenticated existing ERP permissions; no new user grants or anonymous/admin fallback. Retain inventory source document audit and original failed logs. Run relevant unit tests and safe Release build/full unit suite. Real SQL must target exact (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with IntegratedSecurity and a new GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject existing/wrong target before access, never drop/reset or read production settings. Include two independent connection race tests where applicable. Build completion never implies stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Add optional SourceSalesOrderDetailId to preloading detail with exact Domain/EF/idempotent repository schema code and authorized bounded candidate/read evidence. Resolve actual parent order/customer/product and live existing sales-order plus pre-loading permissions/data scope. Null-source historical lines stay explicitly unlinked; never backfill/guess references. Reject invalid/deleted/cancelled/unapproved order, wrong product/customer versus booking and positive quantity violations before any edit assignment; preserve allowed base-unit semantics, no cross-product/unit sums or amount/currency mixing.

Serialize linked demand approval against upstream sales-order rows and existing booking/preloading boundary in deterministic order; cumulative effective approved linked preloading per source detail may not exceed authorized order detail quantity. Keep cancelled preloading history and release operational planning capacity; explicitly state that this is demand planning evidence, not inventory reservation or shipment. Invalid later line or competing approvals must roll back/limit total. Preserve ERP353 and ERP348 guards, audit, actual enabled identity and all existing menu grants. Verify actual controllers/services on dedicated SQL own/foreign demand, wrong source/product, failed edit unchanged, cumulative overflow and two-connection race; add no production or external operation.
